query:
SELECT control_number, sequence_number, violator_id, status_description, gdate_happened, gdate_paid, original_fine, actual_fine, is_discounted, violation_type_description, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, district, city, region
FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation
WHERE city = 'الرياض'
ORDER BY gdate_happened DESC
LIMIT 1000
raw_question: عطني جدول اخر الف مخالفة مرورية في مدينة الرياض
